nodes.title: PROMPT PREVIEW - assembled text after Run
READ FIRST - two-image comparison
widgets_values:
# Hon Dolo: one controlled A/B comparison
A: the baseline reference edit, without a LoRA.
B: the same edit with Civitai Candid Film enabled at 0.5.

Both branches share the same original design, cropped likeness reference, assembled prompt/styles, fixed seed, Euler sampler, four steps and CFG 1. Each branch retains its own matching text/reference encoding and sampling pipeline. Change B ONLY - Candid Film strength to test that adapter. Keep the two engines' model/encoder/VAE choices identical for a controlled comparison.

Run evaluates both Save nodes and can generate TWO images. Cloud runtime applies. Save nodes also display their generated images; they cannot preview an unrun result. Outputs use distinct A/B prefixes. Cached previews may belong to a previous run.

For prompt/crop checks without generation, use the separate Hon Dolo - Prompt and Reference Check workflow. It is an independent copy; transfer selected prompt/style/image/crop settings explicitly. This comparison is also independent of the main Reference Edit workflow.

Styles A/B are editable text presets: select 0 none, 1 film, 2 flash, 3 overcast, 4 stage. Keep multiline off and preserve the empty first line. Style choices apply equally to BOTH branches and are distinct from the model LoRA. Start with 0/0. Negative prompting remains inactive at CFG 1; describe desired corrections positively.

This is whole-image reference-guided regeneration, not a hard identity/background lock. Review identity, expression, jewelry and unwanted drift before tattoo/grill finishing.

The Candid Film creator examples use Klein 9B BASE; we are testing its effect on the distilled 9B recipe. Earlier separate baseline/LoRA stills completed. The paired layout passed server conversion and a dry-run check. It has NOT rendered yet; these checks do not establish output quality. The saved Civitai provider key and new-resource imports remain untested.

Tutorial inspiration: episode 5, shared text and controlled comparisons. This is our existing Klein reference editor, not an SD3 graph. Wolf motion tests remain separate.
